name: Mei Mo Xin Qi
source:
Erica and John are newlywed and have all sorts of happy and loving lives together.
John, however, has been taking on a big project in his company recently and is having a hard time.
Seeing John, erica decided to help him on his own, work together as a couple to have a wonderful future.
